item.title: New Dimension 20 Season Officially Announced
item.description: The Intrepid Heroes can't be stopped. Dimension 20 's Toylight campaign wrapped up last week, but fans won't have to wait too long for their favorite actual play series to return. On Tuesday, Dropout revealed the next season of Dimension 20 will be A Starstruck Odyssey season 2 and it will start next year.

item.title: Cyberpunk 2 Listing Hints at Multiplayer Quests in CD Projekt Red Sequel
item.description: A good sequel builds on what came before while retaining what worked the first time around. So with Cyberpunk 2 , the upcoming sequel to Cyberpunk 2077 , CD Projekt Red will likely want to retain the open-world William Gibson-esque fun of its 2020 RPG while giving players something new.

item.title: GTA 6 Install Size Officially Revealed
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 promises to be the biggest Grand Theft Auto game yet, with an expansive and modern-day take on Rockstar Games' version of Miami: Vice City. The city and surrounding regions will be full of NPCs, cars and other vehicles to steal, and locations of varying seediness to visit. Expect everything to be bigger, more photorealistic, and more detailed than in previous GTA games. So expect GTA 6 to be big — really big — and clear out some storage space in anticipation of the game's November digital-only launch.

item.title: 8 MW4 DMZ beginner's tips to help you conquer Hajin
item.description: If you want to stand the best chance of getting out alive, you need our DMZ tips for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 . The series finally has a proper extraction mode and while it's not quite what was advertised ahead of launch, there's a lot of fun to be had by heading into Hajin, mowing down dozens of PvE enemies, and extracting with the best loot you can find.

item.title: Dune: Part 3 Final Trailer Reveals Key Change From the Books
item.description: The finale of Denis Villeneuve’s Dune trilogy is almost here, and Dune: Part Three ’s latest trailer leaves a lot to be excited about. The new teaser opens with a clearly changed Paul Atreides (Timothée Chalamet) using The Voice on his legal wife, Princess Irulan (Florence Pugh), to pry out information. She spills that there’s an active assassination attempt against him involving his former partner, Chani (Zendaya).

item.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave’s Leaked Endings Are Extremely Weird
item.description: A bunch of Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave leaks hit the internet over the past 48 hours, thanks to AI-assisted jailbreaking . I worry for the naive person responsible for the leak, given Nintendo's track record of hunting down leakers and pirates . But I'm also a bit worried about some of these endings as a fan of the game. A bunch of them are good! But more than a few really aren't, and that's before getting into how depressingly straight they all are. Whether they're fated for the game's upcoming DLC expansion is another matter, though.

item.title: I Spied on the WoW: Forever Beta as an Invisible God with the Blizzard Devs Who Made It
item.description: I'm standing amid this hubbub as a silent, invisible observer. The Forever development team has invited me to an in-game tour on the live servers. I'm asked to roll an Alliance character; I hold my nose and do so. The team magically boost me to level 30 (the beta's cap) and make me invisible to other players and in-game monsters. My guides then teleport me around the game's vast map, including into new zones not yet unlocked in the beta.

item.title: 'Kingdom Come: Deliverance' Studio Hit by Major Cyberattack
item.description: Kingdom Come: Deliverance developer Warhorse Studios appears to be the latest game studio hit by a cyberattack. The studio confirmed in a statement that it was affected by a cybersecurity incident and is currently assessing the extent of the damage. Czech-based Warhorse is apparently working with cybersecurity experts and “relevant authorities” as it opens an investigation.

item.title: Target Black Friday Leak Reveals Big Deals for Pokémon TCG Fans
item.description: It may not be November yet, but retailers are already planning how they'll handle the year's biggest shopping event: Black Friday. Target has offered Black Friday deals on the Pokémon trading card game in previous years, and 2026 looks to be no different.

item.title: Pokémon Center Opens More Baffling 30th Anniversary TCG Orders
item.description: Pokémon 's Eevee-themed 30th Anniversary Battle Deck is scheduled to drop on Oct. 30 . A week after that is the release date for the highly-awaited Pokémon 30th Anniversary Ultra Premium Collection , the most expansive (and expensive) product in the celebratory lineup. Is The Pokémon Center doing pre-orders for either of these things this Tuesday? Of course not. The official pocket monster storefront is currently selling new trading card game items from the 30th Anniversary repertoire, yes, but its selection is as random as it is baffling.
